title: Bespoke letterform outlines
slide_intent: Show letterform construction at large scale so designers can examine the details that give a voice its character.
strategic_value: Rounded letterforms and accents can provide O2 with a consistent typographic character across messages.
demonstration: Enlarged white vector outlines of lowercase letterforms and diacritics cross a vivid-blue field, with visible curve nodes and cropped edges.
practical_value: Inspect curves, counters and diacritics together when evaluating whether a typeface has a coherent character.

content_islands.name: Letterform construction
content_islands.spec: Place oversized white outlines and their curve nodes across the blue canvas, preserving the cropped outer characters.

content_islands.name: Diacritic forms
content_islands.spec: Show round dots and an angled accent above the repeated lowercase forms.

reference_purposes.Expression: The outlined glyphs demonstrate rounded bowls, terminals and accent shapes.
reference_purposes.Application: Visible curve nodes expose the construction of the bespoke lettering.
